subject: project:gdl
value:
FULL 24-ENTRY RETRIEVAL PILOT, SCORED AGAINST EACH FUNCTION'S ACTUAL CLOSING DIFF, LEAVE-ONE-OUT APPLIED: 12 HIT, 9 PARTIAL, 3 MISS. But the decomposition is the finding, and it inverts the headline: ELEVEN of the twelve hits came from a list that is BYTE-IDENTICAL FOR ALL 24 QUERIES, and only ONE came from a channel that responded to the function at all.

METHOD. Each function was rewound to its manifest pre state, its residual signature captured verbatim from `fndiff --ops`, and the three queries an agent actually runs (`context <fn>`, `brief <tu>`, `laws --residual <signature>`) executed against the live graph. Ground truth is the mechanism the historical matching commit REALLY used, read from `git show <post>` per entry, not from the manifest's prose -- and the diffs corrected the manifest on four rows (ProcCamera is four mechanisms not one addressing form; shop_show_lv is decl-split + typed view + dead-pointer reuse + a constant fix, not just a typed view; ScrollMessageBox block-scopes an unused local rather than dropping it; InitTexMod rewrites an if/else-if chain as a switch as well as adding the view struct). HIT = a surfaced item names the closing mechanism; PARTIAL = names its family or an adjacent lever; MISS = neither. Every hit was confirmed by READING the crediting law's full text, because keyword scoring is measured unsound.

THE THREE CHANNELS, MEASURED.

(1) `context <fn>` IS EMPTY ON THIS POPULATION -- 24 of 24. Twenty-one rows returned ZERO records. The three that returned anything returned exactly ONE record each (ProcCamera_8002E548, PlayerCollidePlayers, LinkItemTriggers) and ALL THREE are excluded by the protocol's leave-one-out screen: each is its own closer's write-up, dated on or after its match commit, and each names the cure outright. After the screen, `context` contributed NOTHING on 24 of 24 closable functions. This generalises the run-32 pilot's finding (a) from n=4 to n=24 with no exceptions. AGENTS.md discipline 11 makes `context <fn>` mandatory step zero before the first edit; on CLOSABLE functions its measured value is screening for parks, vetoes and ownership, never finding a cure.

(2) `brief <tu>`'s LAW LISTS ARE A GLOBAL CONSTANT. `matching_laws` (59 items) and `core_screen_laws` (34) are BYTE-IDENTICAL across all 24 briefs -- one distinct list each, shared by 24 of 24 TUs. They are a corpus dump, not TU-scoped retrieval, and they are ~93 of a brief's ~100 items. The genuinely TU-scoped channels (open_hypotheses, vetoed_axes, live_attempts, tu_mentioned_laws, webfrank_pins) are always about SIBLING functions in the TU, correctly so, since the function under test is matched.

(3) `laws --residual` NEVER DISCRIMINATED, ON ANY OF THE 24. It returned one of exactly THREE behaviours, selected by the signature's boilerplate PHRASING rather than by the function: 13 rows whose signature reads `IDENTICAL (N/N) -- pure reorder` returned a constant 6-law payload, sha1 6c8feea5048d; 4 rows whose signature reads `IDENTICAL (N/N) -- but K IMMEDIATE word(s) differ` returned a DIFFERENT constant 5-law payload, sha1 c75a343b38ce; the 7 count-asymmetric rows returned 124, 128, 152, 162, 168 and 176 laws -- 60% to 85% of the corpus's 207 -- and one (LinkItemTriggers) returned ZERO. So the index is either a constant, a near-total dump, or empty. This EXTENDS claim.law.RS_residual-retrieval-is-blind-to-pure-reorder-residuals.20260902.v1: the degeneracy is not confined to pure reorder, there is a SECOND constant class, and even the count-asymmetric case that the RS law bounded as 'where terms exist' does not narrow -- it widens to most of the corpus.

WHERE THE HITS ACTUALLY CAME FROM. Eleven of twelve came from the constant 59-item `matching_laws` dump, at fixed positions that are the same for every function: fn_8009190C and sndFxQueUpdate (rank 10, local-alias-vs-direct-global-spelling-diverges -- names the axis, and explicitly tells you to read the direction off the target, which is right, since these two rows need OPPOSITE directions); padButtonReleased (rank 59, counter-first-while-form -- demote the for to a while and write the increment as a statement, which is the cure verbatim); DoWorldAnimSub and getNewPosRectUnique (ranks 29/40, declaration-initializer-split-controls-entry-schedule -- verbatim); ScrollMessageBox (rank 13, dead-nominal-local-area-tracks-declaration-count); PlayerCollidePlayers (ranks 15/18/29); LinkItemTriggers (rank 38, IT_empty-bodied-if-elides-its-own-comparison -- the target's dead compare needs a NON-empty body, and the cure was adding `dup2++` to an empty if); AtreeNodeInsert (rank 21, dead-local-identity-reuse-flips-callee-saved-coloring -- the cure substitutes the dead PARAMETERS for fresh locals); MBClearTexscroll (rank 47, explicit-offset-accumulator-places-induction-updates-early -- the exact induction axis, with the tell for choosing the direction); shop_show_lv (ranks 21/29/39/40). EXACTLY ONE hit came from a query-responsive channel: start_audioslider, via `brief.tu_mentioned_laws` rank 1 of 4, claim.law.single-base-relocation-refutes-symbol-separation, whose one-HA/LO-pair discriminator is precisely the diagnostic that yields the optionsStringPool anchor cure.

HISTORICAL AVAILABILITY, THE HONEST DEFLATOR. Eleven of the twelve crediting laws were RECORDED AFTER the function they credit was matched. Only PlayerCollidePlayers had a crediting law predating its close, by one day (explicit-fp-symbol-vs-literal-zero-regression, 2026-08-30, vs a 2026-08-31 match). So 12/24 measures TODAY's corpus coverage against YESTERDAY's problems; as a statement about what retrieval could historically have delivered, the number is 1/24.

CORRECTION TO THE RUN-32 PILOT. It scored PlayerCollidePlayers as a HIT at `laws --residual` rank 4 and ExtractYPR as a PARTIAL at rank 4 of the same query. Both payloads are now measured to be the constant 6-law set returned identically for all 13 pure-reorder rows, so 'rank 4' was a position in a constant, not a retrieval rank. It also scored AtreeNodeInsert a MISS; the mechanism is in fact named at rank 21 of the constant global list, which that pilot did not score. Its qualitative conclusions stand and are strengthened; two of its per-row attributions do not.

ROWS (id | hit/partial/miss | channel | rank | one-line justification). ProcCamera_8002E548 | PARTIAL | global-constant | 14,30 | lwzu-idiom and if-else-arm-swap name two of the four closing mechanisms; the leading gCameraState byte-base with `cp += 0xC8` is named nowhere. beginSaveTransaction | MISS | -- | -- | assignment-in-expression as an argument-pinning device appears in no surfaced item. fn_8009190C | HIT | global-constant | 10 | alias-vs-direct-global spelling is the exact axis; direction read off target as the law directs. sndFxQueUpdate | HIT | global-constant | 10 | same law, opposite direction, same axis. CalcAnimation | PARTIAL | global-constant | 10,21 | alias-spelling family surfaced; alias-of-a-PARAMETER is not covered. padButtonReleased | HIT | global-constant | 59 | for-to-while demotion with the increment as a statement is the cure verbatim. DoWorldAnimSub | HIT | global-constant | 29,40 | declaration/initializer split, verbatim. ExtractYPR | PARTIAL | global-constant | 29,50 | decl-order and block-textual-allocation family; web-splitting by fresh per-branch names not named. getNewPosRectUnique | HIT | global-constant | 39,40 | declaration/initializer split, verbatim. WorldObjCollide | PARTIAL | global-constant | 30,46 | branch-shape family surfaced; the assignment-in-expression capture used four times is named nowhere. ScrollMessageBox | HIT | global-constant | 13 | dead nominal locals size the frame; the cure removes one from the declaration list. PlayerCollidePlayers | HIT | global-constant | 15,18,29 | literal-zero-vs-named-symbol plus the decl hoist. LinkItemTriggers | HIT | global-constant | 38 | empty-bodied if elides its compare, so the body must be non-empty. AtreeNodeInsert | HIT | global-constant | 21 | dead already-declared storage substituted for fresh locals. start_audioslider | HIT | TU-SPECIFIC | tu_mentioned_laws 1/4 | single-base-relocation discriminator yields the pool anchor. pbCameraUpdate | PARTIAL | TU-SPECIFIC | tu_mentioned_laws 1/2 | repeated-fp-pool-literal law touches the constant routing; the two scoped pragmas and the forced-inline helper are absent. TowerInit | PARTIAL | global-constant | 6 | the live-zero copy-vs-remat family is surfaced but asserts the residual is allocator-not-source, the REVERSE of the cure that worked; the opt_propagation lever is absent. pbSetDORegs | MISS | -- | -- | neither opt_lifetimes nor the operand-order flip `x = b + x` is named. fn_800C2C74 | PARTIAL | TU-SPECIFIC | live_attempts | a sibling record names the view-struct device; the body is a reconstruction no record can supply. joyGetStatus | MISS | -- | -- | count-asymmetric = unwritten code was classifiable, but no item supplies the extern signatures or the state machine. InitMemHandler | PARTIAL | global-constant | 22 | regnorm-is-the-only-screen-that-sees-a-wrong-reloc-symbol would have found the DemoHeap/__OSCurrHeap and gLowMemMode/gDemoMode substitutions; the static-inline helper split is absent. InitTexMod | PARTIAL | global-constant | 30 | if-else arm order controls fallthrough placement is the adjacent lever; the cure is a switch rewrite. MBClearTexscroll | HIT | global-constant | 47 | explicit-offset-accumulator vs base+i*stride is the exact induction axis. shop_show_lv | HIT | global-constant | 21,29,39,40 | decl/initializer split plus dead-pointer identity reuse, both verbatim.

LIMITATIONS, stated so the number is not over-read: single scorer who knew the ground truth while reading the results; this measures RETRIEVAL ONLY (does the mechanism appear, and through which channel), never whether an agent would recognise and apply it -- only the two-arm trial in claim.method.RS_graph-utility-regression-set-protocol answers that. The channel decomposition, the 24/24 empty-context result, the byte-identical brief lists and the residual-index constants are mechanical and do not depend on the scorer's judgment; the hit/partial/miss split does.
